% Three xbar plots with a 4pt gap, negative values from zero.
% Behaviour U1-U4.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xbar=4pt, bar width=6pt]
  \addplot coordinates {(2,1) (-1,2) (3,3)};
  \addplot coordinates {(1,1) (2,2) (-2,3)};
  \addplot coordinates {(3,1) (1,2) (2,3)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
